name: Society Pass Incorporated

profile.description: Society Pass was a SE Asia digital ecosystem across Singapore, Vietnam, Indonesia, Philippines, and Thailand. Filed Chapter 11 bankruptcy May 12, 2026 (Houston Case No. 26-90525). Nasdaq delisted May 21, 2026. Stock untradeable. TTM revenue ~$7.1M, net losses ~$10.2M.

innovation.label: WEAK
innovation.analysis: Track Record (0/3): Failed to build viable business in 5 years. Filed Chapter 11, delisted [1][2]. Dec 2025 AI pivot never executed [4]. AI Deployment (0/2): No AI products or strategy. Market Share (0/2): Negligible in SE Asian digital commerce vs Grab, Shopee, GoTo. Product Pipeline (0/2): In bankruptcy. R&D Intensity (0/1): No meaningful R&D.

inspiration.label: WEAK
inspiration.analysis: Mission Floor (1/4): Generic digital ecosystem. Community Impact (0/2): No resources given bankruptcy [1]. Employee Retention (0/2): Bankruptcy destroys stability. Insider Buying (0/2): No buying given collapse.

infrastructure.label: WEAK
infrastructure.analysis: LIQUIDITY FLOOR TRIGGERED: Delisted May 21, 2026. yfinance returns no data. Pre-delisting daily dollar volume ~$122K, well below $1M minimum [3]. All metrics dire: -143% profit margin, -18% revenue growth, Chapter 11 bankruptcy [1][2].

ai_resilience.label: HIGH RISK
ai_resilience.analysis: AI Risk Protection (4/9): Digital marketing/e-commerce with meaningful AI exposure. AI tools displacing manual services. Grab/Shopee AI widening competitive gap [2]. Local merchant relationships provide some protection. Existential threat was insolvency, not AI. AI Opportunity (0/1): Dec 2025 AI data centre announcement had zero execution before bankruptcy [4].

infinite_game.summary: Chapter 11 bankruptcy with delisting is not an infinite game. Expanded into 5 countries without product-market fit. Dec 2025 AI pivot five months before bankruptcy reveals trend-chasing not purpose [1][4].

just_cause.analysis: Just Cause (0/3): No Just Cause. Multi-country expansion followed by AI pivot suggests trend-chasing. Chapter 11 is ultimate evidence of expansion over sustainability [1].

trusting_teams.analysis: Trusting Teams (0/2): Bankruptcy destroys trust. CEO transition from founder. ~200 employees across 5 countries thinly spread [1].

worthy_rivals.analysis: Worthy Rivals (0/1): No evidence of learning from Grab, Shopee, GoTo despite their vastly superior resources and focused strategies.

existential_flexibility.analysis: Existential Flexibility (0/2): Maintained failing strategy as revenue declined. Dec 2025 AI pivot never executed. Forced bankruptcy restructuring is not Sinek flexibility [2][4].

courage_to_lead.analysis: Courage to Lead (0/2): Aggressive expansion across 5 countries while burning cash exceeding revenue represents reckless capital allocation [1].

investment_thesis: No bull case. Chapter 11 filed May 12, 2026. Nasdaq suspended trading May 21 [1]. TTM revenue $7.1M against losses of $10.2M — burned $1.43 per $1 revenue [2]. AI data centre pivot never executed. Inspire Score 33 (ALIGNED) cannot offset complete value destruction.
thesis_continued: Risks existential. Chapter 11 may wipe equity — shareholders last behind creditors [1]. Delisting eliminates liquidity. SE Asian commerce dominated by Grab, Shopee, GoTo with orders-of-magnitude more resources. ~$15M cash subject to bankruptcy costs [2][3].
key_catalysts: Successful Chapter 11 restructuring — highly speculative, never demonstrated operational turnaround [1]
Potential acquisition of user base (3.3M) and merchant network (205K) by larger SE Asian platform
Nasdaq delisting appeal — unlikely given bankruptcy and prior compliance violations [1][3]
key_risks: Chapter 11 equity wipeout — shareholders last in liquidation [1]
Delisted and untradeable — permanent capital trap [3]
Revenue -18% YoY at -143% profit margin — fundamentally broken model [2]
